audit.why: Kit: Spell Shield (E) cd 24/22.5/21/19.5/18, eats one targeted ability and refunds mana + move speed. Boomerang Blade (Q) cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, hits going out and coming back — the return trip is the punish window.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with the real E cooldown range and added the Q return-trip cooldown note.

edits.before: - Sivir Spell Shield: matchup-defining — Eats your key spell and refunds her mana — bait it with a cheap cast first. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Relentless Pursuit like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Spell Shield (E): 24s cd at rank 1, 18s at rank 5 — eats your key spell and refunds her mana, bait it with a cheap cast first. - Boomerang Blade (Q) is 10s at rank 1 — punish the return trip. - Guard Relentless Pursuit for the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: W-mark trades begin: the bolt's mark feeds your duo's procs; the lane is already a 2v2 you rigged.
edits.after: At level 2 your Q plus passive out-trades Sivir before Boomerang Blade and Ricochet come online.

edits.before: E joins: dash-weave the full string — your burst window out-damages everything in the role at 3.
edits.after: With E mobility online at level 3 you control every trade against a stationary, gap-closer-less Sivir.

edits.before: String the contacts on cooldown: Q-aa-E-aa-W-aa — six shots in two seconds; the lane should flinch.
edits.after: Through levels 4-5 your burst windows punish Sivir every time her Spell Shield is on cooldown.

edits.before: The Culling online — the corridor execute punishes every disengage that runs straight.
edits.after: The Culling out-bursts anything Sivir can answer before she completes two items.

edits.before: First item spike: the string deletes half bars. The act peaks here — cash it.
edits.after: Your first item spikes the all-in harder than her Ricochet farming curve.

edits.before: Late Lucian dashes the seams: string the carry, dash the answer, and cull the corridor they retreat through.
edits.after: At two-plus items her waveclear, On The Hunt speed, and utility outscale your lane lead — close it early.

edits.before: Dashing in first against a held answer — Lucian's E is the string's spine; spent on style, the act is a mime.
edits.after: At two items her waveclear and On The Hunt speed let her split a fight — dash the isolated target, not the group.
